title: ClearPath First-Suspension Relief on Reinstatement Fees
content:
**Relief clause.** The first-suspension relief on the reinstatement fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the reinstatement fees already posted on the agreement in the last 24 months (a month window ending today) and the payments posted on the agreement in the last 12 months (a month window ending today):

(a) with no earlier reinstatement fee in that 24-month window and 9 or more payments, 50 percent of the fee is charged;

(b) with no earlier reinstatement fee in that window and fewer payments, 75 percent is charged;

(c) with an earlier reinstatement fee in that window, the whole fee is charged.

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. Reinstatement fees and payments are counted from the agreement's billing ledger by posting date; each payment entry counts once.

**Truth table.**

| Earlier reinstatement fee in the last 24 months | Payments in the last 12 months | Share of the fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| none | 9 or more | 50 percent |
| none | 8 or fewer | 75 percent |
| one or more | any | 100 percent |

**Hypothetical cases (today 2025-10-01).** A reinstatement fee posted 2023-10-01 is 24 whole months old and outside the window; one posted 2023-10-02 is inside it. With no earlier fee in the window and 11 payments in the year, half the fee is charged: on a fee taken as 200.00 for illustration, 100.00 before any other change to the fee.
